```
['build a multimodal transformer model by extending BaseTransformer and implementing the required abstract methods', 'build a transformer backend by extending BaseTransformerBackend and implementing build_transformer_config and build_embeddings', 'build a transformer head by extending BaseTransformerHead and implementing the forward method', 'review the BaseTransformer build method which constructs backend, encoders, heads, losses and initializes weights', 'review the get_optimizer_parameters method to understand how learning rate groups are configured for heads and encoders']
```

